impact.en: Increased earthquake activity or minor tremors reported in known fault zones
impact.sw: Kuongezeka kwa matetemeko madogo katika maeneo yanayojulikana kuwa na mipasuko ya ardhi

en: Please follow official information from the Geological Survey of Tanzania (GST), TMA and Disaster Management Committees.
Households: identify safe spots in each room, away from windows and heavy objects.
Village/Mtaa and Ward Disaster Management Committees: review earthquake contingency plans and update the list of people with special needs.
sw: Tafadhali fuatilieni taarifa rasmi za Wakala wa Jiolojia na Utafiti wa Madini Tanzania (GST), TMA na Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa.
Kaya: bainisheni sehemu salama katika kila chumba, mbali na madirisha na vitu vizito.
Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa za Vijiji/Mitaa na Kata: pitieni mipango ya dharura ya tetemeko na boresheni orodha ya watu wenye mahitaji maalum.

impact.en: Tsunami watch after a large earthquake elsewhere in the Indian Ocean
impact.sw: Tahadhari ya tsunami baada ya tetemeko kubwa mahali pengine katika Bahari ya Hindi

en: Coastal communities: please follow TMA tsunami bulletins on radio and TV.
Know the route to higher ground.
Please do not go to the beach to watch the sea.
sw: Jamii za pwani: tafadhali fuatilieni taarifa za TMA kuhusu tsunami kupitia redio na televisheni.
Fahamuni njia ya kwenda maeneo ya mwinuko.
Tafadhali msiende ufukweni kutazama bahari.

impact.en: Households and workplaces not prepared for shaking
impact.sw: Kaya na maeneo ya kazi kutokuwa tayari kwa mtikisiko

en: Practise Drop, Cover and Hold On with your family.
Fix heavy shelves and cupboards to walls.
Prepare an emergency bag: water, food, torch, radio and first-aid kit.
sw: Fanyeni mazoezi ya Inama, Jifunike na Shikilia pamoja na familia.
Fungeni kwa ukuta rafu na makabati mazito.
Andaeni begi la dharura: maji, chakula, tochi, redio na vifaa vya huduma ya kwanza.

impact.en: Cracks appearing in older buildings
impact.sw: Nyufa kujitokeza katika majengo ya zamani

en: Check walls and foundations for new cracks.
Report serious cracks to Village/Mtaa leaders.
Please avoid sleeping in rooms with serious cracks until they are inspected.
sw: Kagueni kuta na misingi kuangalia nyufa mpya.
Toeni taarifa ya nyufa kubwa kwa viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.
Tafadhali epukeni kulala kwenye vyumba vyenye nyufa kubwa hadi vikaguliwe.

impact.en: Rumours and false predictions about earthquakes
impact.sw: Uvumi na utabiri wa uongo kuhusu matetemeko

en: Please rely only on information from GST, TMA and the Prime Minister's Office.
Do not share unverified messages on social media.
sw: Tafadhali tegemeeni taarifa za GST, TMA na Ofisi ya Waziri Mkuu pekee.
Msisambaze ujumbe usiothibitishwa kwenye mitandao ya kijamii.

impact.en: Higher risk for people with special needs
impact.sw: Hatari kubwa zaidi kwa watu wenye mahitaji maalum

en: Please agree within families and neighbours who will help older persons, children, pregnant women and people with disabilities.
Share this advisory with neighbours and relatives.
sw: Tafadhali kubalianeni ndani ya familia na majirani nani atawasaidia wazee, watoto, wajawazito na watu wenye ulemavu.
Wapatieni taarifa hii majirani na ndugu.

impact.en: Weak construction in earthquake-prone areas
impact.sw: Ujenzi dhaifu katika maeneo yanayokumbwa na matetemeko

en: Builders: use ring beams, tied roofs and good-quality materials.
Seek advice from the Council engineer before building.
Follow building permits and guidelines.
sw: Mafundi: tumieni mikanda ya zege, paa zilizofungwa vizuri na vifaa bora.
Pateni ushauri wa mhandisi wa Halmashauri kabla ya kujenga.
Fuateni vibali na miongozo ya ujenzi.

impact.en: Schools and health facilities need to be ready
impact.sw: Shule na vituo vya afya kuhitaji kuwa tayari

en: School heads and facility managers: hold earthquake drills.
Mark safe assembly points outside buildings.
Train staff in first aid.
sw: Wakuu wa shule na wasimamizi wa vituo: fanyeni mazoezi ya tetemeko.
Wekeni alama za maeneo salama ya kukusanyika nje ya majengo.
Fundisheni watumishi huduma ya kwanza.

impact.en: Coastal communities need to know tsunami routes and natural warning signs
impact.sw: Jamii za pwani kuhitaji kufahamu njia za tsunami na dalili za asili

en: Village/Mtaa leaders: mark evacuation routes to higher ground.
Learn the natural signs: strong shaking at the coast, the sea suddenly drawing back, or a roaring sound from the sea.
If you notice these signs, move to higher ground immediately without waiting for an official warning.
sw: Viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa: wekeni alama za njia za kuhamia maeneo ya mwinuko.
Jifunzeni dalili za asili: mtikisiko mkubwa ufukweni, bahari kurudi nyuma ghafla, au mvumo mkubwa kutoka baharini.
Ukiona dalili hizi, hamia eneo la mwinuko mara moja bila kusubiri tahadhari rasmi.

impact.en: Communication and response plans need testing
impact.sw: Mifumo ya mawasiliano na mipango ya kukabiliana kuhitaji kujaribiwa

en: District and Ward Committees: test communication chains with Village leaders.
Confirm each committee member knows their role.
sw: Kamati za Wilaya na Kata: jaribuni mfumo wa mawasiliano na viongozi wa Vijiji.
Hakikisheni kila mjumbe wa kamati anajua jukumu lake.

impact.en: Warning status
impact.sw: Hali ya tahadhari

en: Please continue to follow updates from GST, TMA and Disaster Management Committees.
This advisory remains in place until the authorities update or withdraw it.
sw: Tafadhali endeleeni kufuatilia taarifa za GST, TMA na Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa.
Tahadhari hii itaendelea hadi mamlaka zitakapoihuisha au kuiondoa rasmi.

impact.en: Earthquake felt strongly across the area, with light damage
impact.sw: Tetemeko kuhisiwa kwa nguvu katika eneo, na uharibifu mdogo

en: During shaking: Drop, Cover and Hold On.
If outdoors, move to open ground away from buildings, trees and power lines.
If driving, stop in a safe place away from bridges and stay inside.
sw: Wakati wa mtikisiko: Inama, Jifunike na Shikilia.
Ukiwa nje, nenda eneo la wazi mbali na majengo, miti na nyaya za umeme.
Ukiwa unaendesha, simama mahali salama mbali na madaraja na baki ndani ya gari.

impact.en: Aftershocks likely for days or weeks
impact.sw: Mitetemeko ya baadaye inatarajiwa kwa siku au wiki

en: Please be ready to take cover again.
Please do not go back into cracked or damaged buildings.
Sleep outdoors or in inspected safe shelters if your house is damaged.
sw: Tafadhali kuweni tayari kujikinga tena.
Tafadhali msiingie tena kwenye majengo yenye nyufa au yaliyoharibika.
Laleni nje au kwenye makazi yaliyokaguliwa ikiwa nyumba yenu imeharibika.

impact.en: Damage to mud-walled, unreinforced and weak buildings
impact.sw: Uharibifu wa nyumba za tope, zisizo na nguzo imara na majengo dhaifu

en: Please move out of damaged buildings to open ground or official shelters.
Report damage to Village/Mtaa leaders for inspection.
District Committees: mark unsafe buildings and arrange engineering inspections.
sw: Tafadhali hameni kutoka majengo yaliyoharibika kwenda eneo la wazi au makazi rasmi ya muda.
Toeni taarifa ya uharibifu kwa viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa kwa ajili ya ukaguzi.
Kamati za Wilaya: wekeni alama kwenye majengo yasiyo salama na pangeni ukaguzi wa wahandisi.

impact.en: Tsunami threat being assessed after a strong earthquake at or near the coast
impact.sw: Tishio la tsunami linachunguzwa baada ya tetemeko kubwa pwani au karibu na pwani

en: Coastal communities: please move away from the beach and follow TMA bulletins.
If you felt strong shaking at the coast or see the sea drawing back, move to higher ground immediately.
Village/Mtaa leaders: prepare to guide people along evacuation routes.
sw: Jamii za pwani: tafadhali ondokeni ufukweni na fuatilieni taarifa za TMA.
Mkihisi mtikisiko mkubwa pwani au kuona bahari ikirudi nyuma, hamieni maeneo ya mwinuko mara moja.
Viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa: jiandaeni kuwaongoza watu kupitia njia za uhamishaji.

impact.en: Injuries from falling objects, glass and debris
impact.sw: Majeraha kutokana na vitu vinavyoanguka, vioo na vifusi

en: Give first aid and take the injured to the nearest health facility.
Health facilities: prepare to receive injured people.
Tanzania Red Cross Society: support first aid and psychosocial care.
sw: Toeni huduma ya kwanza na wapelekeni majeruhi kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Vituo vya afya: jiandaeni kupokea majeruhi.
Chama cha Msalaba Mwekundu Tanzania: saidieni huduma ya kwanza na msaada wa kisaikolojia.

impact.en: Disruption to power, water and communications
impact.sw: Usumbufu wa huduma za umeme, maji na mawasiliano

en: Store water, food and medicines for at least three days.
Keep away from fallen power lines and report them to TANESCO.
Use phones only for essential calls.
sw: Hifadhini maji, chakula na dawa za angalau siku tatu.
Kaeni mbali na nyaya za umeme zilizoanguka na toeni taarifa TANESCO.
Tumieni simu kwa mawasiliano muhimu tu.

impact.en: Damage to roads, bridges and ports
impact.sw: Uharibifu wa barabara, madaraja na bandari

en: Please avoid travel until roads and bridges are inspected.
Follow instructions from the Traffic Police, TANROADS and TARURA.
sw: Tafadhali epukeni kusafiri hadi barabara na madaraja yakaguliwe.
Fuateni maelekezo ya Polisi wa Usalama Barabarani, TANROADS na TARURA.

impact.en: Risk of fire from gas leaks and damaged wiring
impact.sw: Hatari ya moto kutokana na kuvuja kwa gesi na nyaya zilizoharibika

en: If it is safe, switch off electricity and close gas cylinders.
Do not light matches or candles if you smell gas.
Report fires: call 114.
sw: Kama ni salama, zimeni umeme na fungeni mitungi ya gesi.
Msiwashe kiberiti wala mishumaa mkihisi harufu ya gesi.
Toeni taarifa ya moto: pigeni 114.

impact.en: Landslides triggered by shaking on slopes
impact.sw: Maporomoko ya ardhi kutokana na mtikisiko kwenye miteremko

en: Residents of steep slopes: please move away from slopes and cliff edges.
Report new cracks or slope movement to Village/Mtaa leaders.
sw: Wakazi wa miteremko mikali: tafadhali ondokeni mbali na miteremko na kingo za majabali.
Toeni taarifa ya nyufa mpya au kusogea kwa ardhi kwa viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.

impact.en: Schools and workplaces affected
impact.sw: Shule na maeneo ya kazi kuathirika

en: School heads: move pupils to safe assembly points and follow directives from the District Education Office.
Use buildings only after they have been inspected.
sw: Wakuu wa shule: wapelekeni wanafunzi kwenye maeneo salama ya kukusanyika na fuateni maelekezo ya Ofisi ya Elimu ya Wilaya.
Tumieni majengo baada tu ya kukaguliwa.

impact.en: Possible contamination of water from broken pipes
impact.sw: Uwezekano wa maji kuchafuka kutokana na mabomba kupasuka

en: Boil drinking water or treat it with chlorine tablets.
Report broken water pipes to the water authority or RUWASA.
sw: Chemsheni maji ya kunywa au yatibuni kwa vidonge vya klorini.
Toeni taarifa ya mabomba yaliyopasuka kwa mamlaka ya maji au RUWASA.

impact.en: Warning status
impact.sw: Hali ya tahadhari

en: Please continue to follow updates from GST, TMA and Disaster Management Committees.
This warning remains in force until the authorities lower or withdraw it.
sw: Tafadhali endeleeni kufuatilia taarifa za GST, TMA na Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa.
Tahadhari hii itaendelea kutumika hadi mamlaka zitakapoishusha au kuiondoa rasmi.

impact.en: Damaging earthquake causing building collapse, deaths and injuries
impact.sw: Tetemeko kubwa linalosababisha majengo kuanguka, vifo na majeruhi

en: Please stay in open ground away from damaged buildings.
District and Regional Committees: activate earthquake contingency plans and report to the Prime Minister's Office – Disaster Management Department.
Please follow instructions from Disaster Management Committees, the Police Force and the Fire and Rescue Force.
sw: Tafadhali bakini katika maeneo ya wazi mbali na majengo yaliyoharibika.
Kamati za Wilaya na Mikoa: amilisheni mipango ya dharura ya tetemeko na toeni taarifa kwa Ofisi ya Waziri Mkuu – Idara ya Menejimenti ya Maafa.
Tafadhali fuateni maelekezo ya Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa, Jeshi la Polisi na Jeshi la Zimamoto na Uokoaji.

impact.en: Tsunami warning issued for the coast
impact.sw: Tahadhari ya tsunami imetolewa kwa maeneo ya pwani

en: Coastal residents: please move immediately to higher ground or inland, as directed.
Please do not return to the coast until the authorities declare it safe; more waves may follow.
Boats in harbour: move to deep water only if there is time and it is safe; otherwise leave the boat and go to higher ground.
sw: Wakazi wa pwani: tafadhali hamieni mara moja maeneo ya mwinuko au mbali na pwani, kama mnavyoelekezwa.
Tafadhali msirudi pwani hadi mamlaka zitangaze kuwa ni salama; mawimbi mengine yanaweza kufuata.
Vyombo vilivyo bandarini: nendeni kina kirefu cha bahari ikiwa kuna muda na ni salama; vinginevyo acheni chombo na hamieni eneo la mwinuko.

impact.en: People trapped under collapsed buildings
impact.sw: Watu kunaswa chini ya majengo yaliyoanguka

en: Report trapped people: call 190 or 114, or inform local leaders.
Please do not enter collapsed buildings; wait for rescue teams.
Fire and Rescue Force: lead search and rescue with the Police Force, JWTZ and the Red Cross.
sw: Toeni taarifa ya watu walionaswa: pigeni 190 au 114, au wajulisheni viongozi wa eneo.
Tafadhali msiingie kwenye majengo yaliyoanguka; subirini timu za uokoaji.
Jeshi la Zimamoto na Uokoaji: ongozeni utafutaji na uokoaji kwa kushirikiana na Jeshi la Polisi, JWTZ na Chama cha Msalaba Mwekundu.

impact.en: Many deaths and injuries
impact.sw: Vifo na majeruhi wengi

en: Take the injured to the nearest health facility.
Hospitals: activate mass-casualty plans.
Health authorities: manage identification and burial of the dead.
sw: Wapelekeni majeruhi kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.
Hospitali: amilisheni mipango ya kupokea majeruhi wengi.
Mamlaka za afya: simamieni utambuzi na maziko ya waliofariki.

impact.en: Damage to schools, health facilities and public buildings
impact.sw: Uharibifu wa shule, vituo vya afya na majengo ya umma

en: Please do not use damaged public buildings.
District Committees: arrange rapid inspection by engineers.
Set up temporary health and learning points in safe open areas.
sw: Tafadhali msitumie majengo ya umma yaliyoharibika.
Kamati za Wilaya: pangeni ukaguzi wa haraka wa wahandisi.
Anzisheni vituo vya muda vya afya na masomo katika maeneo salama ya wazi.

impact.en: Power, water and communications cut for several days
impact.sw: Kukatika kwa umeme, maji na mawasiliano kwa siku kadhaa

en: Use stored water and food sparingly.
Listen to official radio broadcasts.
District Committees: set up emergency water points and give priority to hospitals.
sw: Tumieni akiba ya maji na chakula kwa uangalifu.
Sikilizeni matangazo rasmi ya redio.
Kamati za Wilaya: anzisheni vituo vya dharura vya maji na toeni kipaumbele kwa hospitali.

impact.en: Risk of disease in shelters
impact.sw: Hatari ya magonjwa katika makazi ya muda

en: Drink only boiled or treated water.
Use latrines and wash hands with soap.
Health authorities: set up disease surveillance in shelters.
sw: Kunyweni maji yaliyochemshwa au kutibiwa tu.
Tumieni vyoo na nawini mikono kwa sabuni.
Mamlaka za afya: anzisheni ufuatiliaji wa magonjwa katika makazi ya muda.

impact.en: Large numbers of households displaced
impact.sw: Idadi kubwa ya kaya kukosa makazi

en: Please register at the shelter.
Help older persons, children, pregnant women and people with disabilities first.
District Committees: provide food, water, sanitation and protection in shelters.
sw: Tafadhali jisajilini kwenye makazi ya muda.
Wasaidieni wazee, watoto, wajawazito na watu wenye ulemavu kwanza.
Kamati za Wilaya: toeni chakula, maji, huduma za usafi na ulinzi katika makazi ya muda.

impact.en: Loss of homes, businesses and livelihoods
impact.sw: Upotevu wa makazi, biashara na vyanzo vya kipato

en: Report losses to Village/Mtaa leaders.
District Committees: provide emergency food assistance to affected households.
sw: Toeni taarifa ya hasara kwa viongozi wa Kijiji/Mtaa.
Kamati za Wilaya: toeni msaada wa dharura wa chakula kwa kaya zilizoathirika.

impact.en: Strong aftershocks causing further collapse
impact.sw: Mitetemeko mikubwa ya baadaye kusababisha majengo zaidi kuanguka

en: Please return to buildings only after engineers declare them safe.
District Committees: cordon off unsafe buildings.
GST: provide regular updates on aftershocks.
sw: Tafadhali rudini kwenye majengo baada tu ya wahandisi kuthibitisha kuwa ni salama.
Kamati za Wilaya: wekeni uzio kuzunguka majengo yasiyo salama.
GST: toeni taarifa za mara kwa mara kuhusu mitetemeko ya baadaye.

impact.en: National and international support required
impact.sw: Msaada wa kitaifa na kimataifa unahitajika

en: Prime Minister's Office – Disaster Management Department: coordinate national resources and request international support where needed.
District Committees: send regular situation reports through the Regional Committee.
sw: Ofisi ya Waziri Mkuu – Idara ya Menejimenti ya Maafa: ratibuni rasilimali za kitaifa na ombeni msaada wa kimataifa inapohitajika.
Kamati za Wilaya: wasilisheni taarifa za hali mara kwa mara kupitia Kamati ya Mkoa.

impact.en: Warning status
impact.sw: Hali ya tahadhari

en: Please rely on official sources: radio, GST, TMA, Disaster Management Committees and local leaders.
Disaster Management Committees will announce when the danger has passed and when it is safe to return.
sw: Tafadhali tegemeeni taarifa rasmi: redio, GST, TMA, Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa na viongozi wa eneo.
Kamati za Usimamizi wa Maafa zitatangaza hatari itakapokwisha na itakapokuwa salama kurudi.
